_why: Every pass/fail threshold lives HERE as data, never as a literal buried in gate code. Change a limit by editing this file; the gate re-reads it each run.
_whyMaxBodyMassG: PFV-100 body is ~23g of 316L (measured by the CAD worker). 100g caps the family with headroom while catching a wrong-density or runaway-geometry rebuild.
_whyRequiredMaterial: PFV family spec material, exact string from family.yaml (material: 316L stainless). Any other string fails the gate.
_whyReleaseFromState: Release is legal only from the Approved workflow state (domain workflow table: Approved->Released).
_whyRequiredReleaseRole: Mirrors the domain workflow edge Approved->Released, which requires the EngineeringAdmin role.
